pre.speaker: narrator
pre.text: Smoke over the millet. A rebel band has fired the threshing floor, and the elders have barred the village gap with carts. Women stand on the carts with hoes.

pre.speaker: vs-militia
pre.text: Your banner! Whoever you are, the fire is between us and them, and when it burns down they will come through the gap.

pre.speaker: zhang-fei
pre.text: Then we go through the smoke first.

pre.speaker: liu-bei
pre.text: Keep the elders behind the carts. Their chief is the one to break; the rest will run when he does.

post.speaker: narrator
post.text: The Raider Chief's men scatter into the stubble. The elders put out what is left of the fire with their own water jars.

post.speaker: vs-militia
post.text: There is rice in the granary still. Take what your men can carry. It would have been theirs by tonight.

post.speaker: liu-bei
post.text: Keep enough to sow. Tell the next village who came.
